proposal.summary: Proposal only, not an accepted policy decision. Instructor disconnect and recovery restart behaviors require explicit instructor re-admission and manual resumption approval rather than automatic recovery or dynamic instructor role delegation.

rules.rule: Only participants with IsInstructor=true can execute PauseShift and ResumeShift commands.
Non-instructor participants attempting PauseShift or ResumeShift are rejected with CommandCode.RoleDenied, recorded in client results.
Instructor admission review gate strictly verifies SessionAdmission.Allows and cannot bypass cryptographic validation.
Upon instructor disconnect, participant input is revoked and roster roles remain immutable; no non-instructor participant is auto-promoted.
A restored shift from a checkpoint starts in Paused=true state by invariant, requiring an authenticated instructor ResumeShift command to proceed.

blockedReason: Instructor leave and recovery restart policy is blocked pending Issue #99 authoritative contract approval. In the absence of ratified #99 recovery authority, automatic mid-shift failover or unsupervised recovery resumption is disallowed.
limits: No verifiable PM policy decision ref is linked to this record. It is an unapproved proposal and must not be read as an approved policy decision; approved=false and decisionState='unapproved_proposal_blocked_by_default' say exactly that.
Implementing safe role gating and paused defaults in code is not evidence that the operational recovery policy itself was approved.
These rules are asserted by tests, not accepted by a human authority. Test assertions are not staff procedure or facility acceptance.
Does not invent official railway procedures or scoring rules.

entries.orderingClaim: FieldCommandPanel exposes IsInstructor property reflecting projected view.Instructor.
PauseShift evaluates IsInstructor and returns null for non-instructors.
ResumeShift evaluates IsInstructor and returns null for non-instructors.
SetAdmissionDecision records instructor admission review decisions and rejects non-instructor callers.
EvaluateAdmission checks IsInstructor, instructor admission decisions, and delegates to SessionAdmission.Allows without bypass.
ApplyReceipt records RoleDenied server rejections into Results ledger.
KindLabel maps PauseShift to '근무정지' and ResumeShift to '근무재개'.
MeasureWireLength computes exact serialized wire length using FastBufferWriter for telemetry calibration.
SetInstructorAdmission stores admission decisions in runtime and synchronizes with commandPanel.
EvaluateConnectionApproval enforces SessionAdmission.Allows cryptographic validation and respects instructor denial.
Approve delegates connection evaluation to EvaluateConnectionApproval, denying unapproved or cryptographically invalid tickets.
OnDisconnected disables participant input and revokes connection without mutating other roster roles.
ProcessAdmissionRequest verifies sender instructor role and session shift before recording admission decision on server.
ProcessAdmissionResponse updates local command panel decisions only upon confirmed server response.
RequestInstructorAdmission transmits admission decision requests across the network wire to the dedicated server.
SubmitPanelCommand enforces snapshot freshness on ResumeShift and allows instructor PauseShift even when input is paused.
Send accumulates exact serialized writer.Length into sentBytes rather than allocated buffer capacity.
DrawCommandPanel renders instructor controls and routes admission buttons through RequestInstructorAdmission wire transmission.
